Registered by BH-1351 because section 7 now scans the sourced class libs; NOT settable from the control plane — it is a path a root lane uses, so only env/global.env on the box moves it. Same row shape as fleet-propagate's.
Read by bin/wake-loop.sh as ${WAKE_BUDGET_STRETCH:-5}. Registered by BH-1165 so it is visible and settable; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.

Read by bin/wake-loop.sh as ${WAKE_CLAIM_LIMIT:-200}: how many wake rows one claim (POST /api/wakes/claim) scans. Anything but an integer in 1..500 is 200 with one log line. A capped scan is deferred, never dropped: the cursor moves only to the highest row scanned, and the rest is the next cycle's claim (BH-2525.2).
Read by bin/wake-loop.sh as ${WAKE_COALESCE_S:-120}. Registered by BH-1165 so it is visible and settable; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.

BH-5521. Read by bin/wake-loop.sh as ${WAKE_CONDUCTOR_FULL:-0}; anything but 0 or 1 is 0 with one log line. Matters only with WAKE_CONDUCTOR_KEYED=1. 0 = a wake never starts an unkeyed (fleet-wide) conductor run: a drain whose wakes name no PR launches nothing and owes nothing, a `*` owed line is dropped, and more than 50 owed keys launch as 50 keyed with the rest put back; the hourly cron sweep and the 5-minute keyed backstop cover the rest. 1 = the old fall-through to an unkeyed run (rollback).

Read by bin/wake-loop.sh as ${WAKE_CONDUCTOR_KEYED:-0}; anything but 0 or 1 is 0 with one log line. 0 = the unkeyed launch (today); 1 = a wake launch hands the conductor the PR keys it drained (MC_ONLY_PR) and the conductor runs only those PRs; the cron sweep still covers everything (BH-1387).
Read by bin/wake-loop.sh as ${WAKE_CONDUCTOR_PER_TICK:-1}. Registered by BH-1165 so it is visible and settable; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.

BH-5521. Read by bin/wake-loop.sh as ${WAKE_CONDUCTOR_SHA_LOOKUPS:-5}; not a number is 5 with one log line. Per drain, how many checks-wake shas that state/merge-conductor/pr-state.tsv cannot place are looked up on GitHub (GET repos/<repo>/commits/<sha>/pulls, one REST read each, bin/lib/wake-conductor-keys.sh); an open PR with that head becomes a keyed launch. Past the limit a sha is counted skipped. 0 = no lookups.

Read by bin/lib/wake-class-queue.sh as ${WAKE_QUEUE_PER_TICK:-1}: queue-class fly launches (fly-dispatch + fly-pool-tick) per wake-loop invocation; 0 = unlimited; a non-number is 1, logged once. A held launch writes state/wake-queue-owed and the next invocation's first drain pays it; the fly-dispatch/fly-pool-tick cron is the backstop (BH-4170).
